name: tpl-precedence-1-goal
task: Move the ball away from the door before you take the key. Then open the door with the key and pick up the box.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the clauses omit the task’s requirement to open the door with the key. Add a hard Response(door_open, has_door_key) to require the key to be held when the door opens; the existing Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) only orders opening before picking up the box.

CHANGES REQUIRED: Response(door_open, has_door_key) adds a requirement the task does not state: it requires the key to be held again after every time the door is open. The task requires opening the door with the key, already captured by Precedence(has_door_key, door_open). Remove this Response clause.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: the hard precedence clauses enforce moving the ball before taking the key, taking the key before opening the door, and opening the door before picking up the box. The hard Existence(target_picked_up) requires the box pickup; the order clauses also force the earlier steps.

texts: Move the ball away from the door before taking the key.
Take the key before opening the door.
Open the door before picking up the box.
